content: (The location is now Thalmor Embassy.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Serana, Thalmor Soldier, Daegon, Flame Atronach, Thalmor Wizard) (MJR fired an arrow.) (MJR unequipped Iron Arrow) (MJR equipped Iron Arrow) (Lydia has entered combat with Thalmor Soldier)

Lydia: Another Thalmor dog falls to my blade. Their kind has no place in Skyrim. Tsavani: This one hopes the fighting does not disturb the kitchens. The Thalmor pay well for good food, but they are not pleasant masters.
Lydia: You serve these pointy-eared bastards, cat? You should be ashamed. Tsavani: This one serves the food, not the politics. But this one does not wish to die tonight. Please, let this one pass.

Lydia: Damn Thalmor and their fire-spirits! My blade took it down, but my arms burn. Tsavani: The master wizard summons dangerous things. This one prefers a warm stew to lightning bolts. Perhaps you and your Dragonborn could use a meal after all this killing?
Lydia: By Dibella's tits, we're in the heart of the snake's nest. I see Elenwen herself.

Lydia: Elenwen herself. The High Elf bitch who thinks she rules Skyrim. My blade thirsts for her blood. Tsavani: Please, do not provoke her. This one has seen what she does to those who defy her. She will have you tortured for days.

Lydia: Another soldier down! But now a frost atronach stands in our path. By the Nine, these Thalmor summon everything they can. Tsavani: This one begs you, let me hide in the pantry until the fighting is done. I do not wish to be frozen solid by that ice-beast.

Lydia: The fighting is done for now. Look at that sky - Dibella herself paints the heavens with her colors tonight. Tsavani: Such beauty after so much blood. This one thanks you for sparing my life. Perhaps the warmth of a fire and some hot stew would be a better use of this night, yes?
